principle: Structural finalization never converts missing scientific authority into a value, predicate, algorithm, proof, endpoint, transition, evaluator, or default.

categories.preservation: Packages expose provider-required or blocked boundaries without defining or invoking the missing provider.
Integrals, kernels, convergence, N, sigma, Synergie, domains, types and failure policies remain unevaluated and untyped unless source authority exists.
Partial or absent proofs are not completed; sufficiency and truth values are not emitted.
Participants are preserved as exact references, while endpoints, direction, runtime arity, properties, composition, inversion, projection, membership and causality remain unresolved.
Active IR selection is explicit; historical candidates remain comparison-only and are never silently promoted.
Source-level conditions such as division_by_zero and undefined_synergy_application remain traceable but are not invented as executable public errors.
A total upstream step list is not made normative unless observable authority requires it; only justified partial-order obligations are published.

Language, naming, ownership, allocation, layout, serialization, concurrency, error transport and internal architecture remain implementation-defined except where an observable contract states otherwise.
